tenderSchedule.title: PC-1507 for establishment of transformer repair centre in Kampli and carrying out repairs to faulty 25/63/100 KVA conventional type (including CSP type) and 25/63/100 KVA BEE Star Rated (3/4/5 Star Rated) Distribution Transformers of O&M Kampli sub-division as per GESCOM specifications with 35 percentage of Fresh Oil and remaining portion by reclaiming burnt oil from the faulty Distribution Transformers (80 percentage of burnt oil provided by the GESCOM)
tenderSchedule.description: PC-1507 for establishment of transformer repair centre in Kampli and carrying out repairs to faulty 25/63/100 KVA conventional type (including CSP type) and 25/63/100 KVA BEE Star Rated (3/4/5 Star Rated) Distribution Transformers of O&M Kampli sub-division as per GESCOM specifications with 35 percentage of Fresh Oil and remaining portion by reclaiming burnt oil from the faulty Distribution Transformers (80 percentage of burnt oil provided by the GESCOM)
tenderSchedule.locationName: GESCOM Superintending Engineer Procurement Corporate Office Gulbarga

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should not be less than 50% the amount put to tender during the last Three (3) financial years i.e. 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26.The Audited balance sheet (including profit and loss account sheet) for the said financial years duly signed by the CAs with UDIN and by authorized signatory of the firm shall be scanned and uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidders shall upload Liquid assets (Cash at Bank plus Term Deposit in any Nationalized or Scheduled Commercial Bank) on or after the date of notification of tender plus Availability of credit facility in an Nationalized or Scheduled Commercial Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender, which shall be supported by certificate issued by any Nationalized or Scheduled Commercial Bank. The said Credit Facility Certificate should possess in the name of the Firm and tender Indent number and the credit facility to be issued in the in the Format Annexed to this bid (ANNEXURE-A). The conditional credit certificates are liable for rejection.Documents to this effect shall be uploaded

The Bidder should possess statutory certificates such as UDYAM/DIC/SSI/MSME issued by Govt. of Karnataka/India for manufacturing/repair of distribution transformers or repair of any electrical equipment's. Documents to this effect shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- statutory certificates such as UDYAM/DIC/SSI/MSME

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall upload self-declaration of having Diploma/Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering or else shall employ 1 (one) number of qualified person who have Diploma/Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering to supervise the process of repair works. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall be capable of repairing minimum 35 No's of transformers (of any capacities/ratings in total) per month and shall be capable for setting up necessary infrastructure at the location as per the scope of the work for repairs within 30days from the date of awarding the work and submit the necessary statutory clearance certificate/authorization letters from concerned authority i.e. Karnataka state Pollution Control Board for the newly established repair center within 90days from the date of issue of LOI, failing to which GESCOM reserves the right to cancel the DWA. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

If the work is awarded, the bidder shall produce documents such as valid GST certificate, ESI, EPF registration and workmen compensation insurance at the time of claim of first bill. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall agree to install web-based CCTV cameras at his own cost as per the GESCOM requirement for monitoring of all the activities in the repair center by the GESCOM, within 30 days from the date of award. The video footage shall be preserved by the bidder and also it is to be presented as and when requested by the GESCOM authorities. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded

The Bidder Shall Furnish a documentary evidence for having technical support by the firm/individual who satisfies the following requirements. In case of technical supporter is a manufacturer, the technical supporter must have manufactured and supplied minimum of 450 Nos of Distribution Transformers (of any capacities/ratings in total) to ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India/Total Turnkey/Partial Turnkey works during the last Five(5) Financial years put together. (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) or In case of technical supporter is repairer, the technical supporter should have repaired a minimum of 225 Nos of failed Distribution Transformers (of any capacities/ratings in total) in any ESCOM of Karnataka in any one of the last Five (5) Financial years. (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). In case of technical supporter is a manufacturer, copy of the order completion certificate for having supplied 450 Nos of Distribution Transformers (of any capacities /ratings in total) against the Purchase Orders/Award issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India duly mentioning PO/Award No. date and quantity and financial year of supply shall be scanned and uploaded. Or In case of technical supporter is repairer, copy of the order completion certificate having repaired 225 Nos of failed Distribution Transformers duly mentioning Award No/PO number and date, quantity repaired, financial year of repair issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs in Karnataka shall be scanned and uploaded.

The bidder shall purchase the DPC wire, EHV grade transformers oil and any other materials required etc., as per IS specifications from manufacture/authorized dealers only in the name of bidder.Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded

The bidder should not have been Black-Listed/short closed/terminated from his contract due to non-performance in execution of works against the order placed by ESCOMs/KPTCL/any other Government Distribution/Transmission utilities including PSUs as on date of bid submission. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contract completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL/ESCOMS. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part may result in rejection of bid.Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

If the bidder is applying for more than one enquiry then the offer of the bidder will be considered to only one enquiry for which the bidder is eligible at the discretion of GESCOM. Acceptance in this regard on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.
The successful bidder shall establish the repair shed with required power supply at their own cost.Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall ensure that the technical supporter have not provided technical support for more than three agencies. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.
